note: Optional translations. English, in the code, is the source of truth; this file is consulted only when REVIT_MCP_LOCALE=zh-Hans. The tag is zh-Hans - Chinese written in the SIMPLIFIED script (BCP 47: language "zh" plus script subtag "Hans"). It is NOT "Mandarin": Mandarin (cmn) names a SPOKEN variety, whereas Hans/Hant describe the writing system, and speakers of several varieties write both. For a string table the script is what matters. Measured against the original sources: simplified forms throughout, no traditional-only characters. These strings are the original authors’ own wording, preserved when the code was converted to English.
